public.description: No token required. Anyone on the internet.

authenticated.description: Any valid Cognito JWT for the environment's user pool.

member.description: Authenticated, and the caller's biztechUsers record has isMember === true.

admin.description: Today: caller's email ends with @ubcbiztech.com. Intended: Cognito group `admin`.

judgingCode.description: Bearer token is any valid code for the event: team, judge or admin. Row-level filtering (a team sees only its own reviews) is the handler's job.

judge.description: Bearer token is a judge code for the event.

judgingAdmin.description: Bearer token is the event's organizer code.

Event.name: Event
Event.description: A BizTech event. Identified by the pair (id, year): the same id recurs across years, e.g. `blueprint` 2024 and 2025. Stored in biztechEvents<stage>.

id.description: URL slug, unique within a year. Lower-case, no spaces.

year.description: Calendar year of the event. Together with `id` this is the primary key.

description.description: Long-form description shown on the event page. Markdown-ish free text.

deadline.description: Registration deadline, ISO-8601 UTC. Registration is closed after this.

capac.description: Capacity. Registrations beyond this are waitlisted.

isPublished.description: Visible to members. Unpublished events are only visible to admins.

isCompleted.description: Event has happened; used to move it to the past-events list.

isApplicationBased.description: Registrations are applications that an admin accepts or rejects, rather than first-come.

members.description: Price in CAD for members. 0 or absent means free.

nonMembers.description: Price in CAD for non-members. Absent means non-members cannot register.

questionId.description: Stable id; the key used in Registration.dynamicResponses.

type.description: Widget type, e.g. TEXT, SELECT, CHECKBOX, UPLOAD. Not an enum today.

charLimit.description: Max answer length for text questions.

questionImageUrl.description: Optional image shown with the question.

partnerRegistrationQuestions.description: Same shape as registrationQuestions, for partners. Declared loosely until it is used through the SDK.

feedback.description: Legacy feedback-form link. Superseded by attendeeFeedbackQuestions.

EventCounts.name: EventCounts
EventCounts.description: Registration tallies for one event, as returned by `GET /events/{id}/{year}?count=true`.

dynamicCounts.description: Per-question answer tallies, keyed by questionId. Shape varies by question type.

Registration.name: Registration
Registration.description: One user's registration for one event. Keyed by the user's email (`id`) and the composite `eventID;year` string, which is the literal attribute name in DynamoDB.

id.description: Registrant's email, lower-case. Joins to User.id.

eventID;year.description: Composite key `<eventId>;<year>`, e.g. `blueprint;2026`. Yes, the semicolon is in the attribute name.

registrationStatus.description: One of registered, checkedIn, waitlist, cancelled, incomplete. Free string on the wire; not enforced server-side.

applicationStatus.description: For application-based events: accepted, rejected, reviewing, waitlist.

isPartner.description: Registered through the partner/company flow. Judges are partner registrations.

basicInformation.description: Name, year, faculty, diet, etc. Shape differs for attendee vs partner; declared loosely for now.

points.description: Gamification points earned at the event.

scannedQRs.description: QR codes this registrant has scanned.

checkoutLink.description: Stripe checkout URL while payment is pending.

User.name: User
User.description: A BizTech account, keyed by email. Created on first sign-in. Membership is a paid annual flag on this record.

year.description: Study year as entered, e.g. `3rd Year`. Free text.

isMember.description: Has an active paid membership. This is the docs' `member` role.

admin.description: Set at creation from the email domain. Not read for authorization anywhere today.

favedEventsID.description: Array of `eventId;year` strings the user favourited.

Team.name: Team
Team.description: A team of registrants at one event (hackathons, case comps). Keyed by a UUID and the composite `eventID;year`. Stored in biztechTeams<stage>.

teamName.description: Display name, chosen by the team.

memberIDs.description: Member emails. Omitted from `teams.list` for non-admin callers.

memberNames.description: Member first names, parallel to memberIDs when present.

scannedQRs.description: QR codes any member has scanned.

pointsSpent.description: Points spent in the event store.

submission.description: Submission link (Devpost, GitHub, …). Empty string when none.

JudgeScores.name: JudgeScores
JudgeScores.description: A judge's five metric scores for one team in one round. The backend has exactly five numbered metrics; what each means is defined by the event's rubric, not the API.

JudgeSubmission.name: JudgeSubmission
JudgeSubmission.description: One judge's scores and feedback for one team in one round, as returned by the feedback endpoints.

judgeID.description: Judge's email. Judges are partner registrations (`Registration.isPartner`).

judgeName.description: Judge display name, if set at submission.

feedback.description: Written feedback. A string or an object keyed by criterion; both occur.

NormalizedTeamScore.name: NormalizedTeamScore
NormalizedTeamScore.description: A team's aggregate for the current round, with judge scores z-normalized so a harsh judge and a generous judge count equally.

teamID.description: `<teamId>;<round>` — the composite feedback key, NOT the bare team id. Split on `;` to get the team.

zScoreWeighted.description: Weighted mean of z-scored metrics across judges. Higher is better.

JudgingSettings.name: JudgingSettings
JudgingSettings.description: Per-event judging configuration and phase. One record per event.

phase.description: `submission`: teams edit their entries, no judging. `prelim`: all judges score their assigned teams. `finals`: finals judges score finalist teams. `closed`: nothing changes; results may be shown.

perTeamJudges.description: How many judges auto-assign gives each team.

finalsTopN.description: How many prelim teams advance to finals by default.

finalsTeamIds.description: Teams in the finals round. Empty until finals are set up.

finalsJudgeIds.description: Judges who score finals. Empty until finals are set up.

showTeamFeedback.description: Teams may see their own reviews and the leaderboard.

allowJudgeSeeOthers.description: Judges may read other judges' reviews. When false, `reviews.list` returns a judge only their own.

anonymizeTeams.description: Hide team names from judges (UI concern; the API still returns names to judges).

lockSubmissions.description: Teams may no longer edit their entries, regardless of phase.

Rubric.name: Rubric
Rubric.description: The scoring rubric for an event. Reviews are scored per criterion against this; totals are computed from it.

scaleMax.description: Highest score on each criterion, e.g. 5 or 10.

scoreMode.description: `points`: total is the sum of raw scores. `weighted`: each criterion is multiplied by its weight.

id.description: Stable id; the key in Review.scores.

JudgingTeam.name: JudgingTeam
JudgingTeam.description: A team being judged. Independent of the `Team` entity used by the main app; hackathon teams are created by organizers or self-registered with a code.

imageUrls.description: Screenshots. URLs only; upload is the client's concern for now.

code.description: Login code for the team's own feedback page. Only returned to `judgingAdmin`.

Judge.name: Judge
Judge.description: A judge for one event. Has no BizTech account; logs in with `code`.

assignedTeamIds.description: Teams this judge scores in prelims, in order.

Review.name: Review
Review.description: One judge's scores for one team in one round. Id is deterministic (`<round>__<teamId>__<judgeId>`) so a resubmit replaces rather than duplicates.

feedback.description: Written feedback. Empty string when none.

total.description: Sum of raw scores, computed server-side from the rubric at submission.

weightedTotal.description: Sum of score × weight, computed server-side.

JudgingLink.name: JudgingLink
JudgingLink.description: A link shown on the portal home page (schedule, Discord, rules).

JudgingSession.name: JudgingSession
JudgingSession.description: Who a code belongs to. Returned by `session.login`; the code itself is then used as the bearer token.

id.description: Judge id or team id. For `judgingAdmin` codes that are not also a judge, the string `admin`.

eventName.description: From JudgingSettings, so the client can render a header without a second call.

event.description: Events. `bt.events` for the collection, `bt.event(id, year)` for one.

list.description: All events across all years, sorted by startDate. Public; unpublished events are included, so filter on isPublished for member-facing UI. Returns the overview projection: description and question arrays are absent.

id.description: Restrict to events with this id (all years).

EventNotFound.description: No event with that id and year.
No event with that id and year.

registrations.description: Every registration for this event, including waitlisted and cancelled. Requires a token.

teams.description: Every team formed for this event. Requires a token; member emails are only included for admins.

registration.description: Registrations. Read-only through the SDK for now; writes still go through the registration form.

MissingFilter.description: Neither email nor eventID+year was given.

list.description: Registrations filtered by registrant email and/or event. At least one of `email` or the (`eventID`, `year`) pair is required; the backend rejects an empty query. Non-admins receive only their own.

eventID.description: Event id (slug). Must be paired with `year`.

year.description: Event year. Must be paired with `eventID`.

output.description: Matching registrations. Empty array when none.

me.description: The signed-in user, resolved from the JWT. A singleton: `bt.me.get()`.

UserNotFound.description: No user record for the caller's email yet.

user.description: Users by email. `bt.user(email).get()` is admin-only; non-admins should use `bt.me`.

get.description: One user by email. Admins only; a non-admin caller gets their own record back regardless of the email given.

team.description: Teams at an event. `bt.teams` for collection actions, `bt.team(id)` for judging actions on one team.

list.description: All teams for an event. Member emails (`memberIDs`) are stripped unless the caller is an admin.

scores.description: Every team's normalized aggregate score for the current judging round. Public. Empty array before any judge has submitted.

TeamNotFound.description: User is not on a team for this event.

forUser.description: The team a user belongs to at an event.

create.description: Create a team with the given members. Members must be registered for the event.

join.description: Add a member to an existing team.

leave.description: Remove a member from their team.

rename.description: Rename the team a user belongs to.

TeamNotFound.description: User is not on a team for this event.

addPoints.description: Add (or subtract, with a negative number) points to the team a user belongs to.

feedback.description: All judge submissions for this team, grouped by round. Note: when the team has no feedback the backend currently returns HTTP 500 or 502 (it throws its 404 inside a try, and API Gateway reports the unhandled throw as 502). Catch ApiError with status >= 500 and treat it as empty until that is fixed.

AllJudgesDone.description: Every listed judge has already scored this team this round.

assignJudges.description: Point the given judges at this team for the current round. Judges who already scored this team in this round are skipped.

legacyJudge.description: The teams service's original five-metric judging flow, keyed by judge email (judges are partner registrations). Superseded by `bt.judging(eventID, year)` for new events; kept for anything still on the old flow. `bt.legacyJudge(email)`.

currentTeam.description: The team this judge is currently assigned to.

currentTeamName.description: Team name, or null if the team record is missing.

submissions.description: Everything this judge has submitted, grouped by round. Note: with no submissions the backend currently returns HTTP 500 or 502 (it throws its 404 inside a try, and API Gateway reports the unhandled throw as 502). Catch ApiError with status >= 500 and treat it as empty until that is fixed.

InvalidScores.description: A metric is missing or zero.

NotAJudge.description: No partner registration for this judge at this event, or already submitted for this team this round.

submit.description: Submit scores for a team in the *current* round (the round is read server-side from `bt.judgingRound`). All five metrics must be non-zero; the backend treats 0 as missing. One submission per judge per team per round.

feedback.description: Written feedback; string or object keyed by criterion.

updateSubmission.description: Edit an existing submission for a team and round.

round.description: Round the submission was made in.

judgingRound.description: The single global judging round counter. A singleton: `bt.judgingRound.get()`. Note it is global, not per event.

round.description: Round identifier, e.g. `"1"`. A string on the wire.

set.description: Set the current round. Affects every subsequent `judge.submit`.

session.description: Code login. `bt.judging(e, y).session.login({ code })` returns who the code is; keep the code as the bearer token afterwards.

scope.name: judging
scope.description: One event's judging. Keyed like Event: (eventID, year).

UnknownCode.description: No judge, team or admin code matches.

login.description: Resolve a code to a role and identity. Public, rate-limited by the gateway. Returns 404 for an unknown code rather than 401 so the response does not distinguish 'wrong code' from 'no such event'.

code.description: The code the person typed. Case-insensitive, whitespace trimmed.

me.description: Who the current bearer code is. Use on page load to restore a session.

settings.description: Event phase and configuration. A singleton per event.

scope.name: judging
scope.description: One event's judging. Keyed like Event: (eventID, year).

EventNotFound.description: No judging has been set up for this event. `settings.set` creates it.

get.description: Current settings. Public so the landing page can show the phase and event name before login.

set.description: Create or replace settings. Creating is how an event's judging is initialized; the admin code is set out-of-band (see the service README).

phase.description: `submission`: teams edit their entries, no judging. `prelim`: all judges score their assigned teams. `finals`: finals judges score finalist teams. `closed`: nothing changes; results may be shown.

perTeamJudges.description: How many judges auto-assign gives each team.

finalsTopN.description: How many prelim teams advance to finals by default.

finalsTeamIds.description: Teams in the finals round. Empty until finals are set up.

finalsJudgeIds.description: Judges who score finals. Empty until finals are set up.

showTeamFeedback.description: Teams may see their own reviews and the leaderboard.

allowJudgeSeeOthers.description: Judges may read other judges' reviews. When false, `reviews.list` returns a judge only their own.

anonymizeTeams.description: Hide team names from judges (UI concern; the API still returns names to judges).

lockSubmissions.description: Teams may no longer edit their entries, regardless of phase.

rubric.description: The event's rubric. A singleton per event.

scope.name: judging
scope.description: One event's judging. Keyed like Event: (eventID, year).

get.description: The rubric. Judges need it to score; teams need it to read feedback.

InvalidRubric.description: No criteria, duplicate criterion ids, or a non-positive scale.

set.description: Create or replace the rubric. Existing reviews keep their scores keyed by old criterion ids; totals are not recomputed.

criteria.description: Criteria in order. At least one.

scope.name: judging
scope.description: One event's judging. Keyed like Event: (eventID, year).

list.description: All teams, sorted by name. `code` is included only for `judgingAdmin` callers.

create.description: Create a team. A login code is generated and returned.

output.description: The new team, including its code.

Forbidden.description: A team code tried to edit a different team.

SubmissionsLocked.description: Phase is past `submission` or `lockSubmissions` is on.

update.description: Replace the editable fields. A team's own code may update its own team while the phase is `submission` and submissions are not locked; admins may update any team at any time.

delete.description: Delete a team and its reviews.

reviews.description: Reviews of this team across rounds. Team codes see them only when results are public.

scope.name: judging
scope.description: One event's judging. Keyed like Event: (eventID, year).

create.description: Create a judge. A login code is generated and returned.

isAdmin.description: Also grant the organizer role. Default false.

output.description: The new judge, including its code.

NoJudges.description: There are no non-admin judges to assign.

autoAssign.description: Round-robin every team to `perTeamJudges` non-admin judges, replacing all existing prelim assignments.

update.description: Rename, toggle admin, or set assignments.

delete.description: Delete a judge. Their reviews are kept.

review.description: Scores. Judges submit with `reviews.submit`; everyone reads with `reviews.list`.

scope.name: judging
scope.description: One event's judging. Keyed like Event: (eventID, year).

Forbidden.description: A team code asked for another team, or results are not public yet.

list.description: Reviews, filtered. Admins see everything. Judges see everything when `allowJudgeSeeOthers`, else only their own. A team code sees only its own team's reviews, and only when `showTeamFeedback`.

InvalidScores.description: A criterion is missing, extra, or out of range.

PhaseClosed.description: The phase is `submission` or `closed`, or this judge is not a finals judge / team is not a finalist.

submit.description: Create or replace the caller's review of a team for the current phase's round. Totals are computed server-side from the rubric. Only allowed while the phase is `prelim` or `finals`; in finals only finals judges may score finalist teams.

scores.description: Keyed by criterion id. Every rubric criterion must be present and within range.

output.description: The stored review with computed totals.

scope.name: judging
scope.description: One event's judging. Keyed like Event: (eventID, year).
